channel.title: Sokol Systems blog
channel.description: Research and practical notes on ad creative from Sokol Systems.

item.title: White-label ad creative for agencies: your options, what they cost, and what to check before you sign
item.description: How agencies outsource ad creative under their own name: published prices for each option, and nine things to check in any white-label partner, from file names to AI rules.

item.title: Creative fatigue on Meta ads: what Meta’s own data says, the signs, and when to refresh
item.description: What creative fatigue is, what Meta’s own research and Ads Manager labels say about it, the five signs to watch, and why refreshing on a schedule is the wrong rule.

item.title: Only half the independent car dealers we checked posted on Instagram in the past month
item.description: We checked the Instagram of 85 independent classic, exotic and luxury car dealers. Only 42 had posted in the past month; 14 had been quiet for over a year.

item.title: Why paid ad creative goes wrong: what 167 reviews and forum posts say
item.description: We read 167 public reviews and forum posts about ads and marketing help that didn’t pay off. Here’s what went wrong most often, what cost the most, and seven questions to ask before you pay anyone.

item.title: Half the local businesses we checked had a Meta ad running for over a year
item.description: We checked the live Meta ads of 35 med spas, restaurants and gyms. Half had an ad running for over a year, and most small advertisers had nothing new beside it.

item.title: What ad creative costs in 2026: freelancers, design subscriptions, in-house and agencies
item.description: Published prices for the usual ways to get ads made, checked in October 2026: freelancers, design subscriptions, an in-house team and creative agencies, and when each makes sense.
